summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py as the last Graph method before ConjunctiveGraph, with a nested add_to_cbd helper that applies rules 1-3 (blank-node recursion guarded by the result's existing subject triples, and reifier triples via rdf:subject). Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase covering the rule counts, typed and untyped reifiers, incoming-reification exclusion, blank node in reifier, blank-node cycle, and source immutability. Nothing was run or committed; expected counts were verified by hand only.
